rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent carved monolith with a clear reflected-pair logic and a central embedded void. The four views generally agree, so it is not merely a one-view trick, and the massing does not depend primarily on stair-step terraces. The main weakness is that the void is still fairly internal and abstract, so its publicness is moderate rather than strong. Overall the geometry appears cleanly resolved, with no obvious cross-view collisions or over-clipping, and it resonates most with courtyard/atrium precedent logic more than with the torqued tower references.
warnings: The void is legible but not strongly opened to the exterior ground plane.
Reference resonance is stronger with courtyard/nest precedents than with the twisted tower precedent.
